onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

trial_pulse_rate.Description: ranged from 5-27Hz, 16Hz boundary for high/low rate

trial_response.Description: correct, incorrect, no center lick, no go-tone lick

init_tone.Description: (sec) time of initiation tone w.r.t the start of the trial (t=0)

stim_onset.Description: (sec) time of stimulus onset w.r.t the start of the trial (t=0)

stim_offset.Description: (sec) time of stimulus offset w.r.t the start of the trial (t=0)

go_tone.Description: (sec) time of go tone w.r.t the start of the trial (t=0)

first_commit.Description: (sec) time of first commit w.r.t the start of the trial (t=0)

second_commit.Description: (sec) time of second commit w.r.t the start of the trial (t=0)

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
